title: Box color-prop background/border uses subtle tokens under visual refresh
answers: Where does Box's color='error'/'success'/etc. background and border come from?
Why does a Box with backgroundColor='warning' look different between legacy and visual-refresh themes?
body: Box's named-color background/border props (error, success, info, warning) resolve through packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Layout/Box/Box.tsx:customBorderColor and customBackgroundColor. Under theme.flags.visualDesignRefresh they use theme.colors[color].subtleBackground / .subtleBorder; otherwise they fall back to the legacy .transparent / .borderTransparent tokens. Any new named-color option added to Box must be wired through both branches to stay consistent between legacy and visual-refresh themes.
applies: grafana-ui Layout/Box component, visual-refresh theme color props
